verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's own marketing names a Transaction Monitoring agent within Mesh agentic workflows. That agent auto-remediates level 1 alerts and escalates high-risk or complex cases for human review, and users can review or override any agent decision, so an in-product agent does work on transaction alerts. The evidence consists only of thin marketing snippets, with no documentation of how the agent investigates or of any review notes or summaries it writes. Missing for 10: documented agent investigation workflow for transaction alerts, agent-prepared review notes or case narratives, first-party docs depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.
